observed_in: Shop and Economy System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls the availability and abundance of currency within the game, affecting how easily players can acquire and utilize resources. Variations can range from plentiful currency that encourages frequent transactions to extreme scarcity that forces players to make tough choices about resource allocation and item usage.
exclusion_criteria: Currency is abundant and freely available
Players can easily acquire currency without consequences
inclusion_criteria: Currency is limited to specific actions or purchases
Players must strategize on which items to buy or sell based on available currency
title: Currency Scarcity in Shop and Economy Systems
